newsitem.title: AUSTRALIA: Dragon in diamond search pact with De Beers.
newsitem.headline: Dragon in diamond search pact with De Beers.

text.p: Australian explorer Dragon Mining NL said on Monday it entered into a letter of agreement with De Beers Consolidated Mines Ltd subsidiary Stockdale Prospecting Ltd to allow Stockdale to explore for diamonds on its tenements.
The agreement allows Stockdale to explore the 1,415 sq km of holdings in the West Pilbara region of Western Australia, earning up to a 75 percent interest, Dragon said.
Stockdale could earn an initial 51 percent interest by spending A$1.5 million within three years, it said.
Dragon, which will contiue to explore for nickel sulphides, base metals and gold, said no diamonds or diamond bearing pipes had been found on its tenements.
However, it said the concept of exploring for diamonds in the region was geologically valid.
